items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Clark Terry. There’s some of the guys that are – I’m going to be missing them

ctx.x: You read my mind. And that’s going to break my heart. He was so – he is just such a sweetheart, and to realize how ill he is. But he would never let on that he was ill. Clark Terry. There’s some of the guys that are – I’m going to be missing them, and I’m not really prepared yet to deal with it.

You are – or at least you used to be, but I haven’t talked to you about it in a long time – you used to keep a pretty good eye on the up and coming talent. I’m wondering who you’re admiring in today’s musical world?
